summary_en: ¥61.00 per share (ordinary ¥55.00 + special ¥6.00). Total ¥177.3M. Record date 2026-05-31, effective 2026-08-28. Payout ratio target 30%+ under progressive dividend policy. Special component reflects one-time tax accounting benefit; ordinary component based on sustainable earnings.
title_en: Notice Regarding Dividend of Surplus (Special Dividend)
translation_en_brief: CNS Co., Ltd. announced on 13 July 2026 that its board has approved a dividend of ¥61.00 per share for the period ending 31 May 2026 (record date 31 May 2026, effective 28 August 2026). This comprises an ordinary dividend of ¥55.00 per share and a special dividend of ¥6.00 per share, totaling ¥177.3M. The company applies a progressive dividend policy targeting a payout ratio of 30% or above, with base point ¥45.00 (May 2023 period). The ordinary component reflects sustainable earnings momentum; the special component acknowledges a one-time increase in profit resulting from a tax accounting review. The dividend is subject to approval at the 41st Ordinary General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for 27 August 2026.
